text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While I'm out with Satono Diamond, we spot Kitasan Black in deep discussion at the greengrocer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: What's the matter, Kita? That's quite the frown you've got there…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Dia! This shop's actually in a bit of a bind…

text_block_list.name: Grocer
text_block_list.text: We're still sitting on a heap of leftover stock, and there are hardly any customers.

text_block_list.name: Grocer
text_block_list.text: Cheap veggies here! Get your fresh, delicious vegetables!

text_block_list.name: Grocer
text_block_list.text: See? This always happens when my favorite baseball team loses. It's some kinda terrible jinx…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Apparently, this happens every single time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Grrr!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You can overcome this jinx! Don't give up! You just need to fight it head on!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Like… What if I were to buy all of your leftover vegetables?
choice_data_list: I think that's going a little far…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Then, we'll find another way! I can't just ignore someone who needs my help!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I know! Let me help you sell them!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Me too! We'll help you break this jinx!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ATTENTION, SHOPPERS!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: WHO WANTS SOME FRESH VEGGIES?!

text_block_list.name: Passerby
text_block_list.text: What the?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black's shouts echo throughout the shopping district, causing people to stop in their tracks.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: We've got fresh, juicy tomatoes and plump, shiny eggplants! Perfect for tonight's dinner!

text_block_list.name: Housewife
text_block_list.text: My, she's certainly full of energy. I think I'll see what the fuss is about.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: All our stock is delicious. ♪ Take a look around.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hehe. This is going really well!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to your powerful voice. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Your customer service is great too! That polite nature of yours is really working here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter… Murmur, murmur…

text_block_list.name: Grocer
text_block_list.text: Wow! This is the first time I've sold so much after my team lost!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. We didn't do anything special. If you had stayed positive, I'm sure business would still have flourished without us.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That's true! I think your shouts were just lacking their usual vigor today!

text_block_list.name: Grocer
text_block_list.text: Maybe you're right! Now that you mention it, I definitely lacked energy back there.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "Don't let the jinx beat you!" "Forget about your superstitions and just have fun!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It you put those feelings into your voice, you can dispel any measly jinx. ♪
choice_data_list: Positivity is the key to all things in life!
Can it really get rid of any jinx?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That's right!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hey, why don't we search for other people bothered by jinxes? We might be able to help!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm coming too! Let's ask the people in the shopping district!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The three of us march around the shopping district on the lookout for undiscovered jinxes!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, do you doubt me? Then I'll just have to break another jinx!

text_block_list.name: Grocer
text_block_list.text: In that case, I actually have one more! When my overall sales are good, people stop buying my cucumbers.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Then we need them to understand how great your cucumbers are! Maybe we can showcase delicious ways to enjoy them?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That might work! I know a three-star chef I can ask for some recipes. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their demonstration is a huge success, and they end up selling all of the cucumbers!
